ccnr_rp.mod.name: CCNR-RP
ccnr_rp.command.usage.gui: 界面：按 K 打开角色管理终端（也可用 /rp character list 刷新）
ccnr_rp.command.usage.faction: 阵营: /rp faction list | relation <a> <b> | relation set <a> <b> <hostile|neutral|friendly> | group list | group create <id> <成员id...> | group relation <g1> <g2> <type>

ccnr_rp.command.usage.animation: 动画: /rp animation list | play <id> [玩家...]
